name: horizon
rationale: A&S horizon T; 10 minutes is long enough for inventory to matter

name: burn-in
rationale: 100 mean order lifetimes, so the initial book is forgotten

name: markout-tail
rationale: longest markout horizon, so fills near T get markouts

name: ref-price
rationale: $100 at $0.01 per tick

name: lo-rate
rationale: limit-order rate at distance 1; with theta gives a few lots at the touch

name: lo-alpha
rationale: power-law decay of the rate with distance, the functional form of CST (2010)

name: lo-levels
rationale: orders land within 10 ticks of the opposite best

name: cancel-hazard
rationale: mean lifetime 3.3 s: the book refills within seconds after a sweep

name: lo-size-mean
rationale: 1 + Geometric sizes, mean 2 lots

name: init-levels
rationale: initial book only; replaced during burn-in

name: init-lots
rationale: initial book only; replaced during burn-in

name: mo-rate
rationale: one market order per second; with the depth gives a spread of 1-2 ticks

name: mo-size-mean
rationale: same size law as limit orders, so most market orders stay at the touch

name: news-rate
rationale: nu: 0 = no informed flow; the stress grid varies it

name: branching
rationale: n_br: mean cluster size 1/(1 - n_br); the stress grid varies it

name: hawkes-decay
rationale: beta: children follow their parent after 0.5 s on average (seconds-scale bursts)

name: inf-size-mean
rationale: same size law as background market orders

name: latency
rationale: 1 ms decision-to-book delay (simplified, fixed)

name: requote
rationale: decision every 100 ms

name: max-inventory
rationale: Q_max: hard position limit

name: quote-size
rationale: one lot per side

name: check-every
rationale: engine invariant checks (tests); 0 = off
